secondary.$description: figma secondaryContainer was green.50 #f1f3f1 (invisible on bg); deepened to green.200 #c7cfc7 so a secondary button/chip clearly stands off the white page — same sage hue

surface-grouped.$description: A grouped section that raised content (Card) sits on. Light: the grey of `muted`. Its own role because dark `muted` is lighter than `card`, which made a card on a group read as recessed. Surface model: TOKENS.md.

accent.$description: Kinetic Weave v1 semantic role; existing token name preserved.

accent-foreground.$description: Kinetic Weave v1 semantic role; existing token name preserved.

destructive.$description: a11y: figma error #ec5047 is 3.33:1 under on-error / 3.62:1 as text on the page — fails WCAG AA. red.500 #c60a0a clears 5.6:1 / 6.1:1. See ACCESSIBILITY-AUDIT.md.

success.$description: synth: no Figma success token; green ramp step 6 (distinct from secondary)

warning.$description: a11y: Figma onWarningContainer #f97907 is 2.7:1 as text on the page / 2.6:1 in the Tag warning variant — fails WCAG AA. amber.800 #7f5b21 clears 6.1:1 / 5.8:1. Dark --warning stays bright (amber.400). See ACCESSIBILITY-AUDIT.md.

ring.$description: Kinetic Weave v1 semantic role; existing token name preserved.

error.$description: figma: error (NOT red.500 #c60a0a — Figma keeps error as its own value)

on-info-container.$description: text on a tinted info surface (bg-info/10) — Banner/Inform information. --info itself is only 4.15:1 on its own 10% tint; this clears AA. Exposed as text-info-on-container.

muted-on-container.$description: secondary text on a tinted container (bg-primary/10, bg-destructive/10 and their /5 variants) — IoT device, group and activity cards. --muted-foreground (neutral.600 #6d6d6d) is tuned against --background and --muted and clears AA there at 5.17:1, but a 10% tint eats the margin: 4.43:1 on bg-primary/10 and 4.33:1 on bg-destructive/10. This is one step darker and clears AA on every tint those surfaces use, worst case 4.79:1 on bg-destructive/10 over --muted, while staying visibly lighter than --foreground. Exposed as text-muted-on-container.

info.$description: the informational status hue, 4.7419:1 on `background`. Synthesized (Figma exposes no info token). Its old description read "distinct from navy primary", which described the pre-Kinetic-Weave palette: primary is now `indigo.600`. The reason the status families stayed on the inherited slate-blue is the same one — an informational state must not read as the interactive colour — so the value is unchanged and only the wording was wrong.

info-foreground.$description: the near-white that pairs with a solid `info` fill, 4.3927:1 on it — below AA, and left as it is because no component draws this pair: Banner, Inform and ResultState use `bg-info/10` with `on-info-container`, which is what check-contrast.mjs measures. A consumer that wants solid-filled info text should pick its own foreground.

scrim.$description: the dimming layer behind a modal surface (Dialog, AlertDialog, Sheet, Drawer, Modal, Command, Tour, mobile Sidebar) on every platform: black at 40%. Black, not `foreground` — in dark `foreground` is near-white and would lift the page toward the dialog's own surface. The alpha is part of the role, so draw it as is (web `bg-scrim`, native `colors.scrim`) rather than adding opacity.

on-info-container.$description: text and icons on a tinted info surface (`info` at 10% over the page) — Banner and Inform information, on every platform. `info` itself is 4.19:1 on its own 10% tint; this is 6.47:1. Web exposes it as `text-info-on-container`; SwiftUI, Compose and Flutter as `onInfoContainer`.

on-success-container.$description: text and icons on a tinted success surface (`success` at 15% over the page) — Banner, Inform and ResultState success, on every platform. `success` itself is 4.20:1 on its own 15% tint over `muted` (a notice inside a muted panel, the tightest surface it ships on) and fails AA there; this is 6.26:1 at the same worst case. Web exposes it as `text-success-on-container`; SwiftUI, Compose and Flutter as `onSuccessContainer`. The same hex as the Figma `semantic.on-success-container`, but this is the per-mode role — the Figma block is light-only, so it cannot be used directly.

on-warning-container.$description: text and icons on a tinted warning surface (`warning` at 15%). Light: the same step as `warning`, which already clears AA at its worst case (4.63:1 over `muted`). It exists as its own role so all four statuses are addressed the same way and a theme that moves `warning` cannot silently take the on-container text with it.

on-destructive-container.$description: text and icons on a tinted error surface (`destructive` at 10%). Light: the same step as `destructive`, which clears AA at its worst case (4.71:1 over `muted`). Named for the `destructive` role it sits on, not `error` — the two names are reconciled separately.

brand.$description: Kinetic Weave v1 semantic role; existing token name preserved.

brand-foreground.$description: Kinetic Weave v1 semantic role; existing token name preserved.

action.$description: the interactive colour (buttons, selected controls). Defaults to `primary`; override `--action` on its own to split the interactive colour from `primary`.

action-hover.$description: Kinetic Weave action at 90% over background; mirrors web alpha state.

action-pressed.$description: Kinetic Weave action at 85% over background; mirrors web alpha state.

focus.$description: focus indicator colour. Defaults to `ring`; override `--focus` to theme focus separately.

link.$description: inline link / Link-button text colour. Defaults to `primary`.
